common.tagline: Private health companion for women with hormonal and lifestyle conditions
common.rule1: The doctor decides; the AI fine-tunes. The AI never overrides a doctor's instruction.
common.rule2: Every answer shows its source. No diagnosis and no changes to medicine doses.
common.rule3: Private by default. You choose what each person and app can see.
common.disclaimer: Wellness & Decision Support: Ritu does not provide medical diagnosis or change prescriptions. Always consult a qualified doctor.
common.emergencyWarning: Emergency Notice: If you experience severe pelvic pain, heavy bleeding, chest pain, fainting, or acute symptoms, call 112 or visit an emergency room immediately.
